phase_name: Add Pressured Fixture and the Positive-Direction Case

objectives.description: Grep both threshold constants out of $GUARD at the new case's site
objectives.note: CASE22_MEM_AVAIL_THRESH / CASE22_SWAP_USED_THRESH read via grep -oE '^NAME=[0-9]+' | cut -d= -f2, with a loud fail() guard if either is empty.

objectives.description: Derive target ratios from thresholds (THRESH/2 and (THRESH+100)/2)
objectives.note: avail target=5 (below 10), swap target=75 (above 50), both exact integer results (MemTotal/SwapTotal=32000000, a multiple of 100), no boundary truncation risk.
fixture-meminfo-pressured written into $WORKDIR with MemTotal/MemAvailable/SwapTotal/SwapFree computed from the derived targets.

objectives.description: Build fresh fixture root via build_fixture and invoke guard with per-invocation override
objectives.note: CASE22_ROOT via build_fixture(); LAKE_BUILD_GUARD_MEMINFO_PATH=... run_guard $CASE22_ROOT preflight, stderr captured to $WORKDIR/c22.err (case 10 idiom), rc captured (case 11 idiom). PSI left at suite-wide clean fixture.

objectives.description: Assert exit code and both reason substrings
objectives.note: Asserts rc=11 and both reason substrings present, built from the Phase 1 literals and the run-time-derived ratio/threshold values (grep -qF, no hardcoded numbers). Verified live: case 22 passes, full suite 28/28 (27 baseline + 1).

objectives.description: Add explanatory comment above the case
objectives.note: Comment block explains the positive-direction rationale and the per-invocation-only override discipline.
